sources.title: Muse — Your Personal AI Agent
sources.snippet: Try Muse, your personal AI agent that gets things done. Give Muse a goal or an everyday task and it handles the rest, from finances and health to shopping and the people you care about.

sources.title: Muse (AI agent) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Muse is an artificial intelligence agent developed by Meta Platforms, announced on 8 September 2026. Meta describes it as a personal AI agent capable of carrying out long-running tasks on a user's behalf, rather than answering queries in a single exchange as a chatbot does. [1]
